tasks.Assess_Dek_Suitability: Assess whether keeping the letter opener on a dek (desk) makes sense based on accessibility and visibility.
tasks.Consider_Refrigerator_Use: Evaluate if storing the letter opener in a refrigerator is practical or necessary given its intended usage.
